scientific_integrity: Exact analytic proofs supplied for the full vertex/facet enumeration and arbitrary signed-mass dual formula. Finite computations check examples but are not used as infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Finite equiradial metric stars with at least two leaves, real-valued functions and sum-normalized bounded-Lipschitz norm. The already known zero-mass dual specialization is background. Unindexed equivalent face classifications may exist.
title: All extreme bounded-Lipschitz potentials on equiradial metric stars
